structure.unit: Default and Enforcement of Security Interest

text.section: Persons that may redeem. A debtor, any secondary obligor, or any other secured party or lienholder may redeem collateral.

Requirements for redemption. To redeem collateral, a person shall tender:
fulfillment of all obligations secured by the collateral; and
the reasonable expenses and attorney's fees described in § 8.9A-615 (a) (1).

When redemption may occur. A redemption may occur at any time before a secured party:
has collected collateral under § 8.9A-607;
has disposed of collateral or entered into a contract for its disposition under § 8.9A-610; or
has accepted collateral in full or partial satisfaction of the obligation it secures under § 8.9A-622.
